reviews.title: Very good crafting table.
reviews.text: This table is perfect for me to diamond paint on. It is a great size, and I love the tilting feature. It was very easy to put together. The only issue for me is the pencil ledge needs to be wider so it can actually hold a pencil. The ledge is pretty much useless for me. Other than that it is a great table and very high quality materials. I would recommend it as a good crafting table.

I have to say, this was better then I was expecting. It was easy to put together and set up. It fits nicely and the chair is nice too. My only complaint is the sliding shelf.  The brackets were out on wrong from the manufacturer and it's so tight, I'm unable to switch it around. I'm still able to use the shelf, it just doesn't slide. Other than that, it's amazing. The drawers are a little flimsy, but I love the cup holder for the pencils. The desk adjusts perfectly
